program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16.0, 8.0, 22.0),     # bottom mirror devices
    "L1":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "gmidc": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),    # cascode devices
    "Lc":    (3.0, 1.0, 6.0),
    "vds1":  (0.14, 0.09, 0.22),    # target Vds of bottom devices
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iin", 20e-6)
    iout = spec.get("iout_target", 5e-6)
    vout = spec.get("vout_nom", 0.9)
    mult = max(1, int(round(iref / iout)))        # number of unit cells on the reference side
    iu = iref / mult                              # unit current = 5 uA
    vds1 = p["vds1"]

    # bottom unit device (identical on both sides)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], iu, vds=vds1, vsb=0.0)
    vgs1 = mb.vgs
    # reference-side cascode: Vds = Vgs1 - Vds1, body effect vsb = Vds1
    vds3 = max(vgs1 - vds1, 0.15)
    mc = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], p["Lc"], iu, vds=vds3, vsb=vds1)
    vgs3 = mc.vgs
    # self-bias resistor: V(top) = Vgs1 + Iref*R = Vds1 + Vgs3
    R = max((vds1 + vgs3 - vgs1) / iref, 100.0)

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # reference branch: iin -> R -> x (bottom gates, cascode drains); cascode gates = iin
    n.R("RB", "iin", "x", R)
    for k in range(mult):
        n.M("M3_%d" % k, "x", "iin", "a", "vss", "nfet", mc.W, mc.L, m=1)
        n.M("M1_%d" % k, "a", "x", "vss", "vss", "nfet", mb.W, mb.L, m=1)
    # output branch (one unit cell)
    n.M("M4", "iout", "iin", "b", "vss", "nfet", mc.W, mc.L, m=1)
    n.M("M2", "b", "x", "vss", "vss", "nfet", mb.W, mb.L, m=1)

    # predictions
    ob = lut.op("n", mb.W, mb.L, vgs1, vds1, 0.0)
    oc = lut.op("n", mc.W, mc.L, vgs3, vout - vds1, vds1)
    gds2 = ob["gds"]
    gm4 = oc["gm"] * 1.15                         # ~15% body-effect gmbs
    gds4 = oc["gds"]
    rout = (gm4 / gds4) / gds2 + 1.0 / gds4
    # residual error: cascode Vds mismatch shielded by cascode gain
    dv = abs((vout - vds1) - vds3)
    err_pct = 100.0 * dv / (rout * iout) + 0.3
    vcomp = vds1 + 0.6 * mc.vdsat
    power = (iref + iout) * 1.8
    return n, {"iout_err_pct": err_pct, "rout": rout,
               "v_compliance": vcomp, "power": power}
